name: Zettlr
description: Zettlr’s inspected updater obtains release metadata and a SHA256SUMS asset through its release service, retrieves the compatible asset, and compares its computed SHA-256 with the parsed checksum before opening it. No independent signing key is visible in this updater code; transport and release-service trust remain outside the read.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; release-specific behavior and external TLS/framework enforcement were not independently audited.
The inspected updater does not show an independent signing key; the external API, HTTPS implementation, and release publication controls were not audited.
